shellCommands.command:
pwd && printf '
-- files --
' && rg --files -g '!node_modules' | head -80 && printf '
-- status --
' && git status --short && printf '
-- direction refs --
' && rg -n "getComputedStyle|direction|rtl|isRTL|dir" src test* . --glob '!node_modules' --glob '!dist' --glob '!coverage' | head -240

printf '%s\n' '-- files --'; find . -path './node_modules' -prune -o -path './.git' -prune -o -type f -print | head -120; printf '%s\n' '-- direction refs --'; grep -RInE 'getComputedStyle|direction|rtl|isRTL|dir' src test tests 2>/dev/null | head -240

printf '%s
' '-- AGENTS --'; sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md; printf '%s
' '-- LightboxRoot --'; sed -n '1,220p' src/components/LightboxRoot.tsx; printf '%s
' '-- RTL tests --'; sed -n '1,240p' test/unit/RTL.spec.ts; printf '%s
' '-- Root --'; sed -n '1,220p' src/modules/Root.tsx; printf '%s
' '-- package --'; sed -n '1,180p' package.json

printf '%s
' '-- Lightbox --'; sed -n '1,280p' src/Lightbox.tsx; printf '%s
' '-- hooks effects --'; sed -n '1,180p' src/hooks/useLayoutEffect.ts; grep -RIn "useLayoutEffect" src | head -80; printf '%s
' '-- test utils --'; sed -n '1,260p' test/unit/test-utils.tsx 2>/dev/null || sed -n '1,260p' test/unit/test-utils.ts; printf '%s
' '-- test config --'; find test -maxdepth 2 -type f -print | sort | head -80

printf '%s
' '-- Portal --'; sed -n '1,260p' src/modules/Portal.tsx; printf '%s
' '-- Inline --'; find src/plugins/inline -type f -maxdepth 2 -print -exec sed -n '1,220p' {} \;; printf '%s
' '-- config --'; sed -n '1,300p' src/config.ts; printf '%s
' '-- contexts RTL --'; sed -n '1,160p' src/contexts/RTLContext.tsx; printf '%s
' '-- eslint hooks rules --'; grep -RIn "exhaustive-deps\|rules" eslint.config.js | head -80
sed -n '1,180p' src/hooks/useForkRef.ts; sed -n '1,100p' src/modules/Navigation/useKeyboardNavigation.ts; sed -n '1,120p' eslint.config.js; sed -n '1,180p' test/unit/setup.ts
